suites.name: Governed Gold Set
suites.meaning: Reviewed-case schemas require current evidence, forbidden evidence, authorization, time, and abstention expectations, then run through persisted evaluation.
suites.limitation: Production qualification requires a private human-reviewed OptimalOS dataset.

suites.name: Entity and identity
suites.meaning: Aliases, mentions, merges, and similarly named entities resolve without crossing scope.

suites.name: Episodic memory
suites.meaning: Meetings, transcripts, speakers, event order, and episode details survive intake and recall.

suites.name: Graph and multi-hop reasoning
suites.meaning: Relationship traversal remains scoped, bounded, and connected to canonical evidence.

suites.name: Citation and evidence quality
suites.meaning: Answers preserve valid source links and expose broken or unsupported citations.

suites.name: End-to-end ingestion
suites.meaning: Sources become governed claims, facts, memories, episodes, and searchable projections without scope loss.

suites.name: Crash and recovery
suites.meaning: Transactions, backups, retries, and rebuilds do not leave partial or corrupted canonical state.

suites.name: Capacity and soak
suites.meaning: Latency, throughput, and reliability remain measurable as request volume and concurrency increase.
suites.limitation: A dedicated large-corpus soak run remains required for production capacity certification.

suites.name: Overload and rate limits
suites.meaning: The Engine rejects excess traffic explicitly, isolates clients, and reports accepted latency honestly.

suites.name: Adversarial mutation
suites.meaning: Noisy variants are generated, while stale distractors and hostile authorization text execute against governed retrieval.
suites.limitation: The public suite uses deterministic mutations rather than an adaptive external attacker.

suites.name: Workflow, skill, and asset governance
suites.meaning: Only eligible workflows, approved skills, and authorized extracted assets enter context.

suites.name: Continuous benchmark history
suites.meaning: Every release can be compared with a prior baseline and regressions remain visible.
